description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer dashboard, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and UI interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table from data and inserts into the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a table cell, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
